source: Original gameplay adaptation; owned GLB models and previously researched Wikidot themes

sites.title: Ruin forge and inverted watch hall
sites.observation: The forge echoes under blue stone, while familiar appliances seem completely out of place.

sites.title: Bone-chime branchwalk
sites.observation: The branches are suspended above an ever-dark forest. Nothing here explains the clattering.

sites.title: Displaced highway junction
sites.observation: A road marker points towards both the near bridge and the far one.

sites.title: Redoubts beyond the crimson keep
sites.observation: The outer defensive platforms return to a courtyard the same height as the first.

sites.title: Twinned mist switchbacks
sites.observation: The ridge remains visible while the path behind it disappears.

sites.title: Two-level service apartments
sites.observation: Empty rooms surround a maintenance hall that still answers to its switches.

sites.title: False-scale balcony quarter
sites.observation: A small door is paired with a gigantic step, without explaining who used either.

sites.title: Split canopy and buried roots
sites.observation: The root arches join across an unseen hollow.

sites.title: Silent ride queue
sites.observation: The queue doubles back under an elevated ride platform, without moving machinery.

sites.title: Afterimage relay fields
sites.observation: The grid changes its color in bands while the static sunset refuses to move.
